evidence.quote: Applications with foreign academic qualifications must be submitted via the uni-assist platform.

notes: Programme is taught in German with English (DAAD: 'Courses are held in German and English'); teachingLanguages de/en. English has no minimum requirement on the DAAD page ('English language skills No minimum language level required'), so no English rule was added. Tuition: the DAAD programme page says 'Tuition fees per semester None' and the university's own From abroad/Costs pages say no tuition fees in Rheinland-Pfalz (applies to all students, including non-EU); the 139 EUR per semester is a Semesterbeitrag (social contribution), not tuition. No dated international application deadline is stated for this Bachelor programme: the programme page gives '31 August for winter semester / 28./29. February for summer semester' without a year, and the university deadlines page says 'There are no special deadlines in place for foreign applicants', so no intake was recorded. Application channel: this university's international pages state foreign-qualification applicants apply via uni-assist (not a VPD/preliminary review), hence de-uni-assist.

evidence.quote: German language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TestDaF: TDN 3
